Top notes are Ylang-Ylang, Peach, Bergamot, Lemon and Green Notes; middle notes are Jasmine, Iris, Orris, Violet, Narcissus and Rose; base notes are Sandalwood, Iris, Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Amber and Musk.

name: Mitsouko Extract
description: Mitsouko Extract by Guerlain is a Chypre Fruity fragrance for women. Mitsouko Extract was launched in 1919. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Guerlain. Top notes are Bergamot, Jasmine, Rose and Citruses; middle notes are Peach, Jasmine, Rose, Lilac and Ylang-Ylang; base notes are Oakmoss, Spices, Cinnamon, Vetiver and Amber.

name: Alien Liqueur de Parfum
description: Alien Liqueur de Parfum by Mugler is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women. Alien Liqueur de Parfum was launched in 2013. Top notes are Jasmine Sambac and Floral Notes; middle notes are Almond and Cashmeran; base notes are Amber and Woody Notes. Alien Liqueur de Parfum by Thierry Mugler is a limited edition fusion between Alien and the world of sprits thanks to a patented method inspired by traditional techniques used to produce the finest Rums. Alien Liqueur de Parfum is aged in toasted oak caskets to reveal a rich and sensual fragrance with woody amber notes that are subtly almondy. It is available in 30ml EDP bottle as limited edition.

name: Carved Oud
description: Carved Oud by Thameen is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men. Carved Oud was launched in 2013. Top notes are Guatemalan Cardamom, Cypriol Oil or Nagarmotha, Cypress and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Agarwood (Oud), Cedar, Patchouli and Iris; base notes are Musk, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Haitian Vetiver and Amber. “Indian Royalty were considered somewhere between man and God and this ritual adornment with perfumes and jewels created something of a super-human presence.The name itself comes from temple designs and decorations and the image of the women, once decorated, as a perfect, carved goddess. A unique oud was selected from the South of India, one of the highest quality oud oils, it is both angular and edgy.The unique oud from the South of India, angular and sweetly edgy, dictates this heavenly scent. The top note blends beautifully with cedar wood and guaiac.At the base, a pure patchouli and sun-baked vetivert add depth and warmth polished off by a smooth, temperate musk. Divine” — press release of the brand.

name: Rouge Trafalgar Esprit De Parfum
description: Rouge Trafalgar Esprit De Parfum by Dior is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Rouge Trafalgar Esprit De Parfum was launched in 2024. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. Top notes are Cherry and Pink Pepper; middle notes are Bulgarian Rose and Turkish Rose; base note is Red Fruits. Dior Rouge Trafalgar Esprit De Parfum is a new fragrance for women and men launched in 2024. Rouge Trafalgar Esprit de Parfum boasts a delicate, scarlet red shade, more intense and dense than ever, portraying a ripe, crisp cherry. The new Esprit de Parfum is darker and deeper due to the use of powerful notes like fiery pink pepper, the delicate yet opulent Turkish and Bulgarian roses, eventuating with a luscious blend of irresistibly delectable red fruits.

name: Derby (Vintage)
description: Derby (Vintage) by Guerlain is a Chypre fragrance for men. Derby (Vintage) was launched in 1985. The nose behind this fragrance is Jean-Paul Guerlain. Top notes are Artemisia, Bergamot, Mint and Lemon; middle notes are Nutmeg Flower, Jasmine and Rose; base notes are Oakmoss, Leather, Sandalwood, Patchouli and Vetiver.

name: Art Of Nature II
description: Art Of Nature II by Lattafa Perfumes is a fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Art Of Nature II was launched in 2024. Top notes are Olibanum, Mandarin, Bergamot and Apple; middle notes are Cardamom, Orange Blossom and Rose; base notes are Vanilla, Musk, Guaiac Wood, Ambroxan and Cedarwood. Lattafa Pride Art of Nature II is a refined unisex fragrance that harmoniously blends vibrant and sophisticated elements. It opens with a refreshing burst of bergamot, olibanum, mandarin, and apple, creating a bright and fruity introduction. The heart reveals a luxurious combination of orange blossom, rose, and cardamom, adding a floral and spicy richness. The fragrance settles into a warm and enduring base of vanilla, ambroxan, guaiac wood, cedarwood, and musk, providing a deep and sensual finish. This elegant scent offers a perfect balance of citrus, floral, and woody notes, making it an exceptional choice for any occasion.Top Notes: Bergamot, Olibanum, Mandarin, Apple Middle Notes: Orange Blossom, Rose, Cardamom Base Notes: Vanilla, Ambroxan, Guaiac Wood, Cedarwood, Musk

name: Homme
description: Homme by Carven is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. Homme was launched in 1999. Top notes are Lavender, Palisander Rosewood, Bergamot, Juniper Berries and Geranium; middle notes are Sandalwood, Virginia Cedar, Nutmeg, Cinnamon, Coriander and Vetiver; base notes are Tobacco, Patchouli, Vanille, French labdanum, Amber, Leather and Musk. Carven Homme is launched in 1999 as a dry woody perfume with aromatic nuances. Top notes: bergamot, lavender, juniper berries, geranium and rosewood. Heart: cinnamon, coriander, nutmeg, cedar, sandalwood and vetiver. Base: leather, labdanum, patchouli, amber, musk, tobacco and vanilla. Available as EDT.

name: Euphoria Amber Gold Men
description: Euphoria Amber Gold Men by Calvin Klein is a Oriental Woody fragrance for men. Euphoria Amber Gold Men was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Laurent Le Guernec. Top notes are Cypress, Thyme and Bergamot; middle notes are Honey, Oregano, Sage and Jasmine; base notes are Amber, Incense, Leather and Vetiver.

name: L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Noir Ambre
description: L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Noir Ambre by Issey Miyake is a Oriental fragrance for men. L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Noir Ambre was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Christophe Raynaud. Top notes are Saffron, Cinnamon, Nutmeg and Coriander; middle notes are Leather, Cedar, Papyrus and Vetiver; base notes are Amber, Vanilla and Tonka Bean.

name: Reef 33
description: Reef 33 by Reef Perfumes is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men. Reef 33 was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Kevin Mathys. Top note is Indian Saffron; middle note is Rosemary; base note is Agarwood (Oud).

name: Porthole
description: Porthole by Loumari is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women and men. Porthole was launched in 2022. The nose behind this fragrance is Camille Chemardin. Top notes are Pineapple, Sea Salt, Bergamot and Iodine; middle notes are Passionfruit, White Blossom and Ginger; base notes are White Musk, Woodsy Notes and Caramel. In immersion, the decor is different. We enter it the way we dive into the world of dreams, the balances are different. The body feels enveloped in it, closely embraced by the crystalline liquid, whose intense blue filters the light and whose singular thickness gives the noise a dull echo and almost palpable waves. The experience is breathtaking, the sensations breathtaking. In the attraction of depth, we abandon ourselves; we almost forget ourselves. But since evolution is in apnea, it is a question of appreciating it. Instinct guides you upwards, it is innate. After evanescence, there is a return to the surface, like a rebirth, it is then to live there a rediscovered virginity, that of the senses. This breath of air is so invigorating, the feeling of the sea air and the burning sun on the skin so invigorating. The moment is enjoyable and explosive. Let PORTHOLE offer you this escape, this olfactory paroxysm. PORTHOLE is a colorful perfume; its iodized notes will make you take off and feel the spray of the waves. Exoticism is at the rendezvous, to be found in the fruity and tangy fragrances of pineapple and a fruit called passion. Resolutely summery, sunny, warm, PORTHOLE is finally suave and greedy, with caramelized notes. He's there, just on the other side of the window.

name: Isolda Cajueiro
description: Isolda Cajueiro by Phebo is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women and men. Isolda Cajueiro was launched in 2018. Top notes are Cashew, Apple and Bergamot; middle notes are Freesia, Orange Blossom and Rose; base notes are Musk, Coumarin and Amber.

name: Seasons Drift
description: Seasons Drift by Riiffs Perfumes is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Seasons Drift was launched in 2025. Top notes are Lemon Zest, Pink Pepper and Grapefruit; middle notes are Cedar, Clary Sage and Ginger; base notes are Sandalwood, Labdanum, Amber and Resin. A timeless and elegant scent that captures the essence of blooming flowers, creating a graceful and captivating olfactory experience.

name: Persian Garden
description: Persian Garden by Kuumba Made is a Floral fragrance for women and men. The fragrance features Exotic floral notes.

name: L'Homme Idéal Cologne Forte
description: L'Homme Idéal Cologne Forte by Guerlain is a fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. L'Homme Idéal Cologne Forte was launched in 2025. The nose behind this fragrance is Delphine Jelk. Top notes are Grapefruit, Lemon Peel and Bergamot; middle notes are Almond and Cinnamon; base notes are Vanillin, Vetiver and Incense.

name: Al Qurashi Blend
description: Al Qurashi Blend by Abdul Samad Al Qurashi is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance for women and men. The fragrance features Agarwood (Oud), Italian Lemon, Sandalwood, Amber, Musk and Lily-of-the-Valley.

name: Black Afgano
description: Black Afgano by Nasomatto is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Black Afgano was launched in 2009. The nose behind this fragrance is Alessandro Gualtieri. Top notes are cannabis, Green Notes, Davana, Saffron and Thyme; middle notes are Resins, Woodsy Notes, Tobacco, Coffee, Cinnamon, Violet and Raspberry; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Incense, Amber, Animal notes, Guaiac Wood, Musk, Tonka, Cedar, Gurjan balsam, Ambroxan and Vanilla. Black Afgano is an oriental woody fragrance created by Alessandro Gualtieri, featuring a dark, resinous composition inspired by high-quality hashish. The scent opens with herbal cannabis and green nuances, transitioning through smoky tobacco and coffee accords before settling into a base of oud, incense, and dense resins. Launched in 2009 after six years of development, this unisex perfume is characterized by its long-lasting sillage and hypnotic, unconventional character.

name: Erba Pura
description: Erba Pura by Xerjoff is a Oriental fragrance for women and men. Erba Pura was launched in 2019. Erba Pura was created by Christian Carbonnel and Laura Santander. Top notes are Sicilian Orange, Calabrian bergamot and Sicilian Lemon; middle note is Fruits; base notes are White Musk, Madagascar Vanilla and Amber.

name: Ganymede
description: Ganymede by Marc-Antoine Barrois is a Woody Spicy fragrance for women and men. Ganymede was launched in 2019. The nose behind this fragrance is Quentin Bisch. Top notes are Saffron and Italian Mandarin; middle notes are Chinese Osmanthus, Immortelle and Violet Leaf; base notes are Mineral notes, Suede, Akigalawood, Musk, Cedar and Patchouli. Ganymede from Marc-Antoine Barrois offers a dreamlike ride on the shores of Lake Maggiore. The couturier and perfumer Quentin Bisch collaborated to bring a contemporary view to the story of Ganymede: this epic moon of Jupiter discovered by Galileo in 1610 and covered with a vast saltwater ocean.

name: Philosykos Eau de Parfum
description: Philosykos Eau de Parfum by Diptyque is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Philosykos Eau de Parfum was launched in 1996. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivia Giacobetti. Top notes are Fig Leaf and Fig; middle notes are Green Notes and Coconut; base notes are Fig Tree, Woody Notes and Cedar.

name: Vanilla | 28
description: Vanilla | 28 by Kayali Fragrances is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women and men. Vanilla | 28 was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Gabriela Chelariu. Top notes are Vanilla Orchid and Jasmine; middle notes are Brown sugar and Tonka Bean; base notes are Amber, Amberwood, Musk and Patchouli. "Captivate the senses with VANILLA | 28, a masterpiece of refined and cultivated nuance. A time-honored union of creamy Jasmine and rich Madagascan Vanilla Orchid draws out the sweet softness of Brazilian Tonka. Beautifully balanced oriental notes of Musk, Oriental, Patchouli and Brown Sugar form the distinguished wood base of this utterly sublime scent." -   a note from the brand.Wear VANILLA 28 alone or layered with others. The fragrance is available as a 100ml Eau de Parfum.

name: Hacivat
description: Hacivat by Nishane is a Chypre fragrance for women and men. Hacivat was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Jorge Lee. Top notes are Pineapple, Grapefruit and Bergamot; middle notes are Cedar, Patchouli and Jasmine; base notes are Oakmoss and Woody Notes. “For the collection named as “SHADOW PLAY” launched in 2017, NISHANE has got the main inspiration from the traditional shadow play which is also known as shadow puppetry, an ancient form of storytelling and entertainment which uses flat articulated cut-out figures (shadow puppets) which are held between a source of light and a translucent screen or scrim. The cut-out shapes of the puppets sometimes include translucent color or other types of detailing. Various effects can be achieved by moving both the puppets and the light source. A talented puppeteer can make the figures appear to walk, dance, fight, nod and laugh.KARAGOZ (meaning “black eye” in Turkish) and HACIVAT (shortened in time from "Hacı İvaz" meaning "İvaz the Pilgrim"), ZENNE (the common name of the generally beautiful and flirty women featuring in various plays) are the lead characters of the traditional Turkish shadow play, popularized during the Ottoman period and then spread to most nation states that comprised the Ottoman Empire and most prominently in Turkey and Greece. The creative directors Mert Güzel and Murat Katran dreamed of bringing the legend of Karagoz & Hacivat into the today’s world. Under the inspiration of their playful characters, the perfume trilogy has been created together with the perfumer Jorge Lee. Just like the theme of these shadow plays, the main objective of NISHANE was to emphasize the contrasting interaction of the people that we can see in every single culture.HACIVAT is a tribute to elegance, competence, and love of art.ZENNE is a tribute to beauty, self-confidence, and flirtation.KARAGOZ is a tribute to wittiness, straightforwardness and sincerity” — press release of the brand.

name: Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait de Parfum
description: Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait de Parfum by Maison Francis Kurkdjian is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women and men. Baccarat Rouge 540 Extrait de Parfum was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. Top notes are Bitter Almond and Saffron; middle notes are Egyptian Jasmine and Virginia Cedar; base notes are Ambergris, Woody Notes, Musk, Ambroxan and Cashmeran. Baccarat Rouge 540 extrait de parfum intensifies the radiance of the three auras found in the eau de parfum without betraying the original inspiration. The perfumer’s mastered craft and the wisdom gained with time gave birth to this woody extrait de perfume, an ultimate accomplishment for Francis Kurkdjian. The Grandiflorum jasmine head note gently underscores the craftsman’s voice. The hint of fire is enhanced with powdered epicurean facets of bitter almond. Lastly, the mineral note built around ambergris is tamed with an ambery and woody accord. Adding to the intensity of the extrait, the perfume bottle also plays with light. Its aesthetic dons a brilliant red robe reminiscent of Baccarat red. Baccarat Rouge 540 Maison Francis Kurkdjian extrait de parfum embodies the profusion and fusion of elements that can only be tamed by the art of the perfumer and the wisdom gained with time.

name: Gypsy Water
description: Gypsy Water by Byredo is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Gypsy Water was launched in 2008. Top notes are Juniper, Lemon, Bergamot and Pepper; middle notes are Pine needles, Incense and Orris Root; base notes are Vanilla, Sandalwood and Amber.

name: Silver Mountain Water
description: Silver Mountain Water by Creed is a Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Silver Mountain Water was launched in 1995. Silver Mountain Water was created by Olivier Creed and Pierre Bourdon. Top notes are Bergamot and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Green Tea and Black Currant; base notes are Musk, Petitgrain, Sandalwood and Galbanum. Silver Mountain Water by Creed is an Aromatic fragrance for men. Inspired by Olivier Creed's fondness for skiing, Silver Mountain Water was designed to evoke the sparkling high-mountain streams of water in the Swiss Alps.The white bottle capped with a silver cap resembles a snow-topped mountain with a glistening silver stream.The fragrance opens with bergamot and mandarin, followed by a heart featuring green tea and black currant. The base is composed of Galbanum, musk, sandalwood and petit grain.

name: Womanity
description: Womanity by Mugler is a fragrance for women. Womanity was launched in 2010. Womanity was created by Mane, Alexis Dadier and Ralf Schwieger. The fragrance features Fig, Caviar, Fig Tree and Fig Leaf. 18 years after Angel and 5 years after extraordinary Alien, Thierry Mugler is saluting femininity. The new edition will thrill all fans of his creations. It is named Womanity and it arrives in stores in mid-June 2010. Thierry Mugler with Womanity plans to launch (for the third time) a bestseller perfume and which will attract the public for years.Womanity is a word created to connect femininity, humanity and city. An overture to this edition began in March 2010 when Mugler launched Womanity.com web site with an idea that every woman cooperates in its creation and finishing touch. With an aim to create contents for the website, one story is finished by several women, each of them writing on her page. Contest asks women to give creative ideas for a particular project or cause. The winner will work with Mugler to finish the website.Fragrance WOMANITY was created as a part of this phenomenon, in a pink bottle. Connections between women are presented as chains and ring on top of the bottle which is decorated with metal frieze with symbolic design. Design of the top part of the bottle and beautiful frieze figures can be interpreted as Gothic or Art Deco style. Mugler's idea was however that the frieze encapsulated and depicted women of all generations.Composition of Womanity was created by Mane, as a powerful contrast of elements. By using the new molecular process of extraction, Mane manages to extract natural aromas of fig for sweet accords. Savory notes originate from caviar and the structure in ensured by fig wood aromas. Pierre Aulas, olfactive director of Clarins Fragrance Group, says that it is a true challenge to work on Mugler's idea of combining savoury and sweet notes.

name: Molecule 01
description: Molecule 01 by Escentric Molecules is a Woody Floral Musk fragrance for women and men. Molecule 01 was launched in 2006. The nose behind this fragrance is Geza Schoen. The fragrance features Iso E Super.

name: You
description: You by Glossier is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women and men. You was launched in 2017. You was created by Dora Baghriche and Frank Voelkl. The fragrance features Iris, Pink Pepper, Ambroxan and Ambrette. "An ambiguous scent that’s hard to describe but easily appreciated. Creamy, sparkling, clean, warm. That’s You."

name: Side Effect
description: Side Effect by Initio Parfums Prives is a Oriental fragrance for women and men. Side Effect was launched in 2016. The fragrance features Rum, Tobacco, Cinnamon, Saffron, Sandalwood and Hedione.

name: Chocolate Greedy
description: Chocolate Greedy by Montale is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women and men. Chocolate Greedy was launched in 2007. The nose behind this fragrance is Pierre Montale. The fragrance features Cacao, Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Bitter Orange, Dried Fruits and Coffee.

name: Allure Eau de Parfum
description: Allure Eau de Parfum by Chanel is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women. Allure Eau de Parfum was launched in 1999. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Polge. The fragrance features Peach, Vanilla, Mandarin Orange, Jasmine, Bergamot, Magnolia, Cedar, Orange Blossom, Vetiver, Rose, Peony and Lotus. Chanel describes Allure as: "Difficult to define, impossible to resist. Clean and sheer, warm and sexy, ALLURE is a floral, fresh Oriental fragrance that finds an expression unique to each woman. Because every woman has her own special allure." And on the composition : "Sparkling notes of Mandarin combine with the softness of May Rose and the sensuality of Vanilla. The Eau de Parfum — closest in strength and character to the Parfum form — features an intoxicating Passion Fruit note with a Peony accord and a warmer Oriental facet."

name: Ambre Sultan
description: Ambre Sultan by Serge Lutens is a fragrance for women and men. Ambre Sultan was launched in 1993. The nose behind this fragrance is Christopher Sheldrake. The fragrance features Resins, Amber, Bay Leaf, Myrrh, Benzoin, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Coriander, Oregano, Patchouli, Angelica and Myrtle.

name: Seminalis
description: Seminalis by Orto Parisi is a fragrance for women and men. Seminalis was launched in 2016. The nose behind this fragrance is Alessandro Gualtieri.

name: Thunderstorm
description: Thunderstorm by Demeter Fragrance is a fragrance for women and men. Thunderstorm was launched in 2009. Thunderstorm is a fragrance presented in April 2009, in a collection which encompasses Rain, Thunderstorm and Holy Water. Thunderstorm is a fragrance which represents the strong and rough side of nature, thunder of summer storm. The fragrance is available as 15ml purse spray, 15ml cologne spray, 30ml cologne spray, 125ml cologne spray...

name: Moringa
description: Moringa by The Body Shop is a Floral fragrance for women and men. Moringa was launched in 2012.

name: Shea
description: Shea by The Body Shop is a Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Shea was launched in 2012.

name: Black No. 05
description: Black No. 05 by Puredistance is a fragrance for women and men. Black No. 05 was launched in 2013. The nose behind this fragrance is Antoine Lie. Puredistance BLACK is created in Paris by the famous French Perfumer Antoine Lie. He created a perfume of the highest quality that is close to the wearer and releases sensual and elegant scent layers in a whispering and sophisticated way – without shouting. A warm, mysterious and elegant fragrance, full of charm, that stays in the shadow, giving away – only every now and then – part of its nature. Puredistance BLACK plays hide-and-seek on the skin, appearing, morphing, and reappearing to delight the senses.

name: Santal Noir
description: Santal Noir by Dior is a fragrance for women and men. Santal Noir was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is François Demachy.

name: Kitten Fur
description: Kitten Fur by Demeter Fragrance is a fragrance for women and men. Kitten Fur was launched in 2017.

name: Rain
description: Rain by Demeter Fragrance is a fragrance for women and men. Rain was launched in 2009. Rain is a fragrance presented in April 2009. It is very strange and almost impossible to describe, since it reinterprets a complex moment of rain in spring. Rain is the purest and the most crystal-like perfume of the entire Demeter collection. It is available as 15ml purse spray, 15ml cologne spray, 30ml cologne spray, 125ml cologne spray...

name: Go Fruity
description: Go Fruity by Zara is a Aromatic Fruity fragrance for women. Go Fruity was launched in 2020.

name: I'm A Musk
description: I'm A Musk by Fine'ry. is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. I'm A Musk was launched in 2023.

name: Cheirosa '62
description: Cheirosa '62 by Sol de Janeiro is a fragrance for women. Top notes are Pistachio and Almond; middle notes are Heliotrope and Jasmine; base notes are Caramel, Vanilla, Salt and Sandalwood. "Sunny yet seductive, the warm scent is bursting with enticing layers of Pistachio and Salted Caramel to keep you cheirosa from sunrise 'til sunset." (from the brand's website)

name: The Most Wanted
description: The Most Wanted by Azzaro is a Oriental Spicy fragrance for men. The Most Wanted was created by Michel Girard, Nadège Le Garlantezec and Shyamala Maisondieu. Top note is Cardamom; middle note is Toffee; base note is Amberwood.

name: The Most Wanted Parfum
description: The Most Wanted Parfum by Azzaro is a Woody Spicy fragrance for men. The Most Wanted Parfum was created by Michel Girard, Nadège Le Garlantezec, Shyamala Maisondieu and Roxanne Kirkpatrick. Top note is Ginger; middle note is Woodsy Notes; base note is Bourbon Vanilla.

name: Bianco Latte
description: Bianco Latte by Giardini Di Toscana is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women and men. The nose behind this fragrance is Silvia Martinelli. Top note is Caramel; middle notes are Coumarin and Honey; base notes are Vanilla and White Musk. "The cuddle, the embrace, the pleasure of being wrapped in a cloud of vanilla, milk and honey." - a note from the brand.

name: Chanel No 19 Eau de Parfum
description: Chanel No 19 Eau de Parfum by Chanel is a Floral Green fragrance for women. Top notes are Green Notes, Bergamot and Neroli; middle notes are Iris, Rose, Narcissus, Lily-of-the-Valley and Ylang-Ylang; base notes are oak moss, Vetiver, Leather and Sandalwood. Number 19 in the name refers to the birth date of Coco Chanel, August 19. The perfume was launched in 1970 when Coco Chanel was 87 years old, a year before she died. It was created by Henri Robert, a perfume creator which created many other perfumes of the Chanel house. Number 19 Eau de Parfum is a floral-woody-green fragrance, a white and green floral harmony. It is a unique blend of light-heartedness and sophistication, not simply a different concentration, but an olfactory reinterpretation, which is faithful to the spirit and base notes of the original composition. Top notes: green notes and bergamot. Heart: rose and iris. Base: vetiver, oakmoss and leather.  Available as 35, 50 and 100 ml EDP.

name: Choco Musk
description: Choco Musk by ALREHAB PERFUMES is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women and men. The fragrance features Vanilla, Milk Chocolate, White Musk, Spicy Notes, Cinnamon, Amber, Sandalwood, Myrrh and Rose.

name: Les Exclusifs de Chanel Coromandel
description: Les Exclusifs de Chanel Coromandel by Chanel is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Polge. Top notes are Bitter Orange, Neroli and Citruses; middle notes are Patchouli, Orris, Rose and Jasmine; base notes are Benzoin, White Chocolate, Woodsy Notes, Incense, Tahitian Vanilla, Olibanum and Musk. Coromandel carries the name of the exotic Chinese lacquered screens. When Gabrielle Chanel first saw them, she proclaimed that she would “faint of happiness” and that she will live surrounded by them.  An amber vibrato is interrupted by dry notes of incense and benzoin. Wooden accords give away the elegance and depth of its magical trail. Coromandel is a rich woody – oriental fragrance, mystical and filled with contrasts.  It belongs to a luxurious collection Les Exclusifs de Chanel and is available in a 200 ml bottle.

name: SpongeBob
description: SpongeBob by SpongeBob Squarepants is a Citrus Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Top notes are Melon, Lemon and Grapefruit; middle notes are Sea Notes and Rosemary; base notes are Musk and Woodsy Notes.

name: Raghba
description: Raghba by Lattafa Perfumes is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women and men. The fragrance features Vanilla, Sugar, Agarwood (Oud), Incense, Sandalwood and Musk.

name: Shaghaf Oud
description: Shaghaf Oud by Swiss Arabian is a Oriental fragrance for women and men. Top note is Saffron; middle notes are Agarwood (Oud) and Rose; base notes are Agarwood (Oud), Praline and Vanilla. "A captivating dance of Oriental opulence with French elegance, Shaghaf Oud is an ardent, fiery mix that holds nothing back." - a note from the brand.

name: Coco Mademoiselle Parfum
description: Coco Mademoiselle Parfum by Chanel is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Polge. Top notes are Bergamot, Orange and Grapefruit; middle notes are Rose, Litchi and Jasmine; base notes are Patchouli, Vanilla, Musk and Vetiver. Coco Mademoiselle was introduced as eau de parfum in 2001, as well as eau de toilette in 2002. Both compositions were created by Jacques Polge – perfumer for Chanel since 1978. Feminine edition Coco Mademoiselle was presented as pure perfume as the very essence of this edition.A richer composition full of contrasts and nuances can be found in 7.5 ml perfume flacons and each of its drops celebrates famous spirit of Chanel's Coco Mademoiselle. A luxurious purse edition arrives in a flacon shaped just like EDP edition, decorated with a seal on its neck.The composition is focused on two characteristic ingredients of Chanel editions – jasmine absolute and May rose absolute. Delicate flowers are enhanced and enriched with a touch of Florentine iris.Top notes of Coco Mademoiselle Parfum incorporate Sicilian oranges, Calabrian bergamot and Sicilian grapefruit. A floral heart is created of pure rose extract and pure jasmine extract, along with a fruity touch of litchi, while its base notes carry a combination of Indonesian patchouli, Haitian vetiver, Bourbon vanilla ad white musk. This fragrance is dedicated to courageous, brave and modern women who prefer luxury and elegance.Chanel Coco Mademoiselle Parfum – fragrant gem can be combined with glittery body gel, which refreshes and seduces with its oriental-fresh notes of citruses in top, flowers and litchi in a heart and cuddling finish in base notes.

name: Pure Seduction
description: Pure Seduction by Victoria's Secret is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. The fragrance features plum, Freesia and Chamomile. Pure Seduction is a fragrance from the Victoria's Secret Secret Garden collection.  A combination of melon, plum and freesia makes you feel utterly irresistible and seductive.  It is available as EDT, body mist and body care collection.

name: Tres Nuit
description: Tres Nuit by Armaf is a Aromatic Spicy fragrance for men. Top notes are Iris, Lemon and Vervain; middle notes are Lavender, Violet and Spicy Notes; base notes are Ambergris and Sandalwood.

name: Club de Nuit Intense
description: Club de Nuit Intense by Armaf is a Chypre Floral fragrance for women. Top notes are Rose, Saffron and Geranium; middle notes are Nutmeg, Pepper, Violet and Caraway; base notes are Patchouli, Agarwood (Oud), Vanilla and Amber.

name: Coconut Passion
description: Coconut Passion by Victoria's Secret is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women. The fragrance features Coconut, Vanille, Lily-of-the-Valley, Chamomile and Aloe Vera. Coconut Passion is a sensual blend of vanilla, coconut and lily-of-the-valley. It belongs to the Secret Garden collection.  It is available as EDT, body mist and body care collection.

name: J'ose
description: J'ose by Eisenberg is a Aromatic Spicy fragrance for women. Top notes are Mint, Amalfi Lemon, Jasmine and Bergamot; middle notes are Lavender, Coffee and Artemisia; base notes are Amber, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Musk, Vanilla, Tonka Bean and Moss. Dare to be…that’s what the campaign of J’ose perfumes says. Unique, mysterious and sensual, this fragrance will exile your personality. It opens with fresh and aromatic notes of lemon, artemisia and mint. The heart is composed of lavender, coffee and mocha, while the base features patchouli, cedar, musk, hay and amber.It is available as 100 ml EDP.

name: Daarej pour Homme
description: Daarej pour Homme by Rasasi is a Oriental Spicy fragrance for men. Top notes are Cumin, Cardamom and Artemisia; middle notes are Rose and Orris Root; base notes are Vanilla, Tonka Bean, Amber, Sandalwood, Patchouli and Musk.

name: Cuba Gold
description: Cuba Gold by Cuba Paris is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. Top notes are Pink Pepper and Grapefruit; middle notes are Lavender and Vetiver; base notes are Vanilla, Amber and Tonka Bean. Cuba Gold is an ultimately masculine scent, inspired by the Cuban cigar.

name: Soft
description: Soft by ALREHAB PERFUMES is a fragrance for women and men. The fragrance features Citruses, Vanilla, Caramel, White Musk, Orchid, Jasmine, Woody Notes and Vetiver.

name: Club de Nuit Woman
description: Club de Nuit Woman by Armaf is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. Top notes are Orange, Bergamot, Grapefruit and Peach; middle notes are Rose, Jasmine, Litchi and Geranium; base notes are Patchouli, Musk, Vanilla and Vetiver.

name: Chi lo vuole, lo può riscoprire. E chi lo riscopre, lo deve scegliere. E come sempre, chi davvero lo sceglie avrà la sua pace la pace appunto del Natale. San Paolo VI
description: Chi lo vuole, lo può riscoprire. E chi lo riscopre, lo deve scegliere. E come sempre, chi davvero lo sceglie avrà la sua pace la pace appunto del Natale. San Paolo VI by Filippo Sorcinelli is a Woody fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Chi lo vuole, lo può riscoprire. E chi lo riscopre, lo deve scegliere. E come sempre, chi davvero lo sceglie avrà la sua pace la pace appunto del Natale. San Paolo VI was launched in 2025. The nose behind this fragrance is Filippo Sorcinelli. Top notes are Metallic notes, Grapefruit, Black Pepper and Galbanum; middle notes are Frankincense, Black Rose, Labdanum and Powdery Notes; base notes are Leather, Java vetiver oil and Oakmoss.

name: Chanel No 5 L'Eau Eau De Toilette 100th Anniversary – Ask For The Moon Limited Edition
description: Chanel No 5 L'Eau Eau De Toilette 100th Anniversary – Ask For The Moon Limited Edition by Chanel is a Floral Aldehyde fragrance for women. Chanel No 5 L'Eau Eau De Toilette 100th Anniversary – Ask For The Moon Limited Edition was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Olivier Polge. Top notes are Aldehydes, Lime, Lemon, Bergamot, Neroli, Orange and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Ylang-Ylang, Jasmine and May Rose; base notes are White Musk, Orris, Vanilla and Cedar. To celebrate the holiday season, discover the limited editions of N°5 EAU DE PARFUM and N°5 L’EAU created to mark the 100th anniversary of the iconic fragrance: two collector's bottles featuring labels embossed with Gabrielle Chanel's lucky number. The biodegradable paper pulp case is molded to hug the shape of the bottle and sealed with an embossed double-C stamp to evoke the fine art of baudruchage, unique to CHANEL fragrances.

name: Chanel No 5 Eau de Parfum 100th Anniversary – Ask For The Moon Limited Edition
description: Chanel No 5 Eau de Parfum 100th Anniversary – Ask For The Moon Limited Edition by Chanel is a Floral Aldehyde fragrance for women. Chanel No 5 Eau de Parfum 100th Anniversary – Ask For The Moon Limited Edition was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Jacques Polge. Top notes are Aldehydes, Ylang-Ylang, Bergamot, Peach and Neroli; middle notes are Iris, Lily-of-the-Valley, Rose and Jasmine; base notes are Sandalwood, Oakmoss, Patchouli, Vetiver and Vanilla. name: Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Blanc Pure Collector Edition Pour Homme x Jeremyville
description: Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Blanc Pure Collector Edition Pour Homme x Jeremyville by Lacoste Fragrances is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. Top notes are Lemon, Ginger and Grapefruit; middle notes are Pomarose, Green Notes and Rosemary; base notes are Suede, Musk and Cedar.

name: Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Sparkling Collector Edition Pour Femme x Jeremyville
description: Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Sparkling Collector Edition Pour Femme x Jeremyville by Lacoste Fragrances is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women. Eau de Lacoste L.12.12 Sparkling Collector Edition Pour Femme x Jeremyville was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Alexandra Monet. Top notes are Rhubarb, Mandarin Orange and Pink Grapefruit; middle notes are Peony, Magnolia Petals and Jasmine Sambac; base notes are Macarons and Patchouli.

name: Международный женский день 8 марта Духи (International Women's Day March 8)
description: Международный женский день 8 марта Духи (International Women's Day March 8) by Новая Заря (The New Dawn) is a Floral Aldehyde fragrance for women. Международный женский день 8 марта Духи (International Women's Day March 8) was launched in 1953. The nose behind this fragrance is Elena Kaboshina. Top notes are Jasmine, Aldehydes, Bergamot, Lily of the Valley, Hyacinth, Green Notes and Orange Blossom; middle notes are Jasmine, Mimosa, Violet, Tonka Bean, Rose, Ylang-Ylang, Patchouli Leaf and Patchouli; base notes are Sandalwood, Amber, Musk, Synthetic Civet and Ambergris. (Pictures of the perfume are provided by the historian and collector Viktoriya Wlasowa).

name: Narciso Rodriguez for Her Eau de Parfum (10th Anniversary Limited Edition)
description: Narciso Rodriguez for Her Eau de Parfum (10th Anniversary Limited Edition) by Narciso Rodriguez is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. Narciso Rodriguez for Her Eau de Parfum (10th Anniversary Limited Edition) was launched in 2013. Top notes are Rose and Peach; middle notes are Egyptian Musk and Amber; base notes are Sandalwood and Patchouli. Narciso Rodriguez celebrates the tenth anniversary of the launch of his most popular and award-winning perfume Narciso Rodriguez for Her. In 2003 the designer said: "It is for all women. It is a gift. It is something very personal of mine that I wanted to give to women." Limited editions Narciso Rodriguez for Her Eau de Toilette and Eau de Parfum (100 ml each) are launched on this occasion in new package design. Additionally, the launch also includes a limited edition of Musc For Her fragrance in concentration of perfume oil (50 ml).  New packages are inspired by couture fashion; they are simple, elegant and luxurious, colored in pink and black shades.

name: Very Irresistible Givenchy Summer Cocktail - Fresh Attitude for Men 2008
description: Very Irresistible Givenchy Summer Cocktail - Fresh Attitude for Men 2008 by Givenchy is a Aromatic fragrance for men. Very Irresistible Givenchy Summer Cocktail - Fresh Attitude for Men 2008 was launched in 2008. The fragrance features Mint, Basil, Grapefruit, Star Anise and Cardamom.

name: Delights of a Passionate Encounter (Delicias de Um Encontro Apaixonante)
description: Delights of a Passionate Encounter (Delicias de Um Encontro Apaixonante) by O Boticário is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. Delights of a Passionate Encounter (Delicias de Um Encontro Apaixonante) was launched in 2013. Top notes are Plum, Apricot, Bergamot and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Jasmine, Ylang-Ylang, Cedar and Lily-of-the-Valley; base notes are Vanila, Sandalwood, Musk and Milk.

name: Ciao Bello Pistachio - Dubaï Chocolate (5th Anniversary Limited Edition)
description: Ciao Bello Pistachio - Dubaï Chocolate (5th Anniversary Limited Edition) by Jousset Parfums is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Ciao Bello Pistachio - Dubaï Chocolate (5th Anniversary Limited Edition) was launched in 2025. The nose behind this fragrance is Jimmy Bodin. Top notes are Pistachio Spread Cream and Brioche; middle notes are Knafeh, Honey and Marzipan; base notes are Milk Chocolate, Pistachio and Ice cream. Perfumer's Note: Gourmand, Pistachio Cream, Fondant Chocolate, Opulent, Almost Edible. Description:  Treat yourself with our decadent pistachio cream, perfectly swirled with the sweet, buttery richness of knafeh wrapped in a crackling shell of silky milk chocolate. Each note melts on your senses like a bite of pure gourmandise!  Top notes: Jousset’s Original Pistachio Spread Cream, Brioche Heart notes: Knafeh (Shredded Dough), Almond Paste, Honey Base notes: Milk Chocolate, Pistachio Ice Cream

name: A Rather Novel Collection 5 O'Clock At Belvoir Castle by Stephen Nilsen
description: A Rather Novel Collection 5 O'Clock At Belvoir Castle by Stephen Nilsen by Anthropologie is a Chypre Floral fragrance for women and men. A Rather Novel Collection 5 O'Clock At Belvoir Castle by Stephen Nilsen was launched in 2009. The nose behind this fragrance is Stephen Nilsen. The fragrance features Bergamot, Jasmine, Sandalwood and oak moss. Anthropologie launches a perfume collection called "A Rather Novel Collection" in 2009. The collection consists of six exclusive fragrance made by five perfumers of Givaudan.5 O'Clock At Belvoir Castle is developed by Stephen Nilsen. The perfume contains notes of bergamot, jasmine, sandalwood and moss.It is available as 50 ml EDP.

name: Irresistible Vibration Beachfront (Irresistivel Vibracao a Beira-Mar)
description: Irresistible Vibration Beachfront (Irresistivel Vibracao a Beira-Mar) by O Boticário is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. Irresistible Vibration Beachfront (Irresistivel Vibracao a Beira-Mar) was launched in 2013. Top notes are Acai Berry, Cherry and Red Berries; middle notes are Damask Rose, White Flowers and Lily-of-the-Valley; base notes are Sugar, Amber and Sandalwood.

name: Black Opium Sparkle Clash Limited Collector's Edition Eau de Toilette
description: Black Opium Sparkle Clash Limited Collector's Edition Eau de Toilette by Yves Saint Laurent is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women. Black Opium Sparkle Clash Limited Collector's Edition Eau de Toilette was launched in 2016. Top notes are Pear and Green Mandarin; middle notes are Tea, Orange Blossom and Jasmine; base notes are Coffee and White Woods. Black Opium Sparkle & Clash Edition is a limited edition bottle of Black Opium Eau de Toilette. Black Opium Eau de Toilette is sensual and luminous scent, giving addiction a touch of brightness. A fusion of green coffee, green pear and white flowers makes this an addictive and sparkling fragrance.  Top notes: green tangerine, pear. Middle notes: jasmine tea petal, orange flower petal. Base notes: green coffee, white woody. Black Opium Sparkle & Clash Edition is layered with over 100 Swarovski crystals.

name: Lolita Lempicka Le Premier Parfum Eau de Toilette (Morsure d'Amour)
description: Lolita Lempicka Le Premier Parfum Eau de Toilette (Morsure d'Amour) by Lolita Lempicka is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women. Lolita Lempicka Le Premier Parfum Eau de Toilette (Morsure d'Amour) was launched in 2011. The nose behind this fragrance is Annick Menardo. Top notes are Almond, Cherry, Vanille, Amalfi Lemon and Apricot; middle notes are Iris, Licorice and Jasmine; base notes are Violet Leaf, Incense and Musk. Le Premier Parfum Eau de Toilette is advertised as "Morsure d'Amour" or "Bite of Love". The fanciful fairytale that began with the first fragrance continues with this new release, the romantic and sensual fragrance that carries sweet taste of sin and embodies the Garden of Eden myth.  Annick Menardo, who signed the original, also creates the new fragrance: “I imagined the licorice flower, which signs the first perfume, dotted with flowers, fruit and wood. It is much more floral, less regressive, less “sugary “than the Eau de Parfum. It is of a more assumed femininity, of a sophisticated elegance. “The composition, inspired by the original but fresher and less sweet, opens with zesty lemon, sour cherries and apricots blended with sweet almond and vanilla. The heart carries a distinctive note of licorice mixed with intense floral bouquet of iris and Sambac jasmine. The mysterious base consists of violet wood, incense and musk.The new bottle takes the form of a bitten apple, keeping the color scheme and the detail of the original. Sylvie de France signs the design again. She believes that this bottle represents a universal symbol that includes all women. The fragrance is available in bottles of 30, 50 and 80 ml of Eau de Toilette concentration.

name: Тройной Одеколон от Наполеона No.3 (Troynoy Odekolon Napoleon No.3)
description: Тройной Одеколон от Наполеона No.3 (Troynoy Odekolon Napoleon No.3) by Новая Заря (The New Dawn) is a Chypre fragrance for men. Тройной Одеколон от Наполеона No.3 (Troynoy Odekolon Napoleon No.3) was launched in 1978. Top notes are Neroli, Bergamot, Lemon, Mandarin and Grapefruit; middle notes are Lavender, Coriander, Rosemary and Mint; base notes are Amber, Musk and Cedar.

name: L'Air du Temps À Paris Chez Antoinette Poisson Edition Limitee 2022
description: L'Air du Temps À Paris Chez Antoinette Poisson Edition Limitee 2022 by Nina Ricci is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women. L'Air du Temps À Paris Chez Antoinette Poisson Edition Limitee 2022 was launched in 2022. L'Air du Temps À Paris Chez Antoinette Poisson Edition Limitee 2022 was created by Louise Turner and Natalie Gracia-Cetto. Top notes are Mandarin Orange, Petitgrain and Bergamot; middle notes are Orange Blossom and Mimosa; base notes are Honey, Tonka Bean and White Musk.

name: Lalique de Lalique 20th Anniversary Chevrefeuille Extrait de Parfum
description: Lalique de Lalique 20th Anniversary Chevrefeuille Extrait de Parfum by Lalique is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. Lalique de Lalique 20th Anniversary Chevrefeuille Extrait de Parfum was launched in 2012. The nose behind this fragrance is Sophia Grojsman. Top notes are Jasmine, Iris, Rose and Clove; middle notes are Cassis, Blackberry and Pear; base notes are White Musk, Sandalwood and Vanilla. Lalique presents a limited edition - Lalique de Lalique 20th Anniversary Chevrefeuille Extrait de Parfum in 2012, to celebrate 20th anniversary of the house. Compositions remains the same as in 1992, and the new, luxurious flacons are available as 40 and 600ml. The flacons are decorated with honeysuckle blossom and created like bottles from 1992 that contained pure perfume Lalique de Lalique. Perfumer of the fragrance is Sophia Grojsman.

name: Black Opium Sparkle Clash Limited Collector's Edition Eau de Parfum
description: Black Opium Sparkle Clash Limited Collector's Edition Eau de Parfum by Yves Saint Laurent is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women. Black Opium Sparkle Clash Limited Collector's Edition Eau de Parfum was created by Nathalie Lorson, Marie Salamagne, Olivier Cresp and Honorine Blanc. Top notes are Pink Pepper, Neroli and Pear; middle notes are Coffee, Licorice, Jasmine and Bitter Almond; base notes are Vanilla, Patchouli, Cashmere Wood and Cedar.

name: Листья томата и черной смородины - Tomato and Black Currant Leaves
description: Листья томата и черной смородины - Tomato and Black Currant Leaves by Brocard is a Floral Green fragrance for women. Листья томата и черной смородины - Tomato and Black Currant Leaves was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is Michel Gouges. The fragrance features Tomato Leaf, Black Currant, Mint, Thyme, Musk, Orange and Jasmine.

name: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau de Toilette Delicate Limited Edition
description: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau de Toilette Delicate Limited Edition by Narciso Rodriguez is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau de Toilette Delicate Limited Edition was launched in 2012. The nose behind this fragrance is Aurélien Guichard. Top notes are Fig and Bergamot; middle notes are Musk, Orange Blossom and Osmanthus; base notes are Vanilla, Vetiver, Amber and Coriander.

name: Absolutely Dark
description: Absolutely Dark by Zara is a Oriental Woody fragrance for men. Absolutely Dark was launched in 2023. The nose behind this fragrance is Marion Costero. "The sensuality and deep elegance of black encapsulated in a fragrance." Created by Marion Costero.Its captivating scent reveals an intriguing blend of invigorating marine and citrus notes. The fragrance is further enhanced by the addition of iris, cashmere and sandalwood, which imbue it with a refined and addictive quality. On a base of mossy woods and amber.

name: Paperback
description: Paperback by Demeter Fragrance is a fragrance for women and men.

name: Cobra
description: Cobra by ALREHAB PERFUMES is a fragrance for women and men.

name: Snow
description: Snow by Demeter Fragrance is a Woody fragrance for women and men. Snow was launched in 2000. The nose behind this fragrance is Christopher Brosius. Snow is unisex fragrance made to smell like snow, fresh, cold, and refreshing. It consists of notes of soil that snow falls on and remains there, with addition of notes of dust. This fragrance has received two FiFi awards in 2000, one of which as the best American fragrance.It is nteresting to mention that the noses of Demeter Fragrance had experienced snow through the story about Eskimos who have seven different words for snow: anniu – snow that snows, api – snow on the ground, siqoq –snowdrifts, upsik – snow blown by wind, kimoaqtruk – snowflake, salumaroaq – smooth snow plane, natatgonaq – scabrous snow planes.

name: Sunshine
description: Sunshine by Demeter Fragrance is a Floral Aldehyde fragrance for women and men. Sunshine was launched in 2013. “What does Demeter’s Sunshine smell like? Think of your favorite, most comfortable cotton T-Shirt left outside and warmed by the sun. We thought long and hard about what elements we could use to express the idea of Sunshine. After a debate that lasted more than a year, we decided Cotton, warmed by the sun, was the smell that best represented the idea of Sunshine Now we had a direction, but executing that direction was easier said than done. It took almost another two years until we felt this fragrance was done. Let us know if you think it was worth the wait.”

name: Impalpable by Michael Cinco
description: Impalpable by Michael Cinco by BENCH/PH is a Citrus fragrance for women and men. Impalpable by Michael Cinco was launched in 2012. Top notes are Bergamot and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Black Currant and Green Tea; base notes are Galbanum, Woody Notes and Musk. Philippine brand Bench continues its Designer Scent Collection and this time collaborates with the famous designer Michael Cinco to launch a very fresh scent called Impalpable.  Top notes: mandarin and bergamot. Heart: black currant and green tea. Base: musk, galbanum and woody notes.  The face of the perfume is Allison Harvard, known as a contestant of America's Next Top Model TV show. The fragrance is available as 90 ml EDP.

name: Leila Lou
description: Leila Lou by By / Rosie Jane is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. Leila Lou was launched in 2010. The nose behind this fragrance is Sarah Horowitz. Top notes are Grass and Nectarine; middle notes are Pear Blossom and Jasmine; base notes are White Musk and Vanilla. Leila Lou is a gentle, fresh and feminine scent. Top notes: nectarine and fresh cut grass. Heart: pear blossom and jasmine. Base: vanilla and white musk. Packaged in simple yet elegant pink and white.It is available as 50 ml Eau de Parfum.

name: Tilly
description: Tilly by By / Rosie Jane is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. Tilly was launched in 2013. The fragrance features Coconut, Grapefruit and Gardenia. A clean fragrance. paraben, phthalate, and cruelty free.Inspired by endless summers on the beach in Sydney, Australia. Tilly includes notes of grapefruit, coconut, and gardenia.Tilly is warm salty skin, after-sun glow, white linen dress. (From the brand's website.)

name: Happiness
description: Happiness by unvisual/parfums is a fragrance for women and men. Happiness was launched in 2017. The fragrance features Whipped Cream, Banana, Black Currant, Pine Tree, Green Tea and Blood Grapefruit.

name: Madness
description: Madness by unvisual/parfums is a fragrance for women and men. Madness was launched in 2017. The fragrance features Black currant leaf, Metallic notes, Ozonic notes, Apple, Leather, Beeswax and Lavender.

name: Sadness
description: Sadness by unvisual/parfums is a fragrance for women and men. Sadness was launched in 2017. The fragrance features Earthy Notes, Green Leaves, Goat hair tincture, Water Notes, Woody Notes and Olibanum.

name: Cabaret Nocturne
description: Cabaret Nocturne by V/SITEUR is a fragrance for women and men. Cabaret Nocturne was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Cécile Zarokian. The fragrance features Tuberose, Animal notes, Powdery Notes, Orange, Gin, Sandalwood, Cumin, Smoke, Tobacco and Pink Pepper. "A pulsating night venue with a different kind of past..." - a note from the brand.

name: Beach Bizarre
description: Beach Bizarre by V/SITEUR is a Aromatic Fruity fragrance for women and men. Beach Bizarre was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Patrice Revillard. The fragrance features Sea Salt, cannabis, Lime, Seaweed, Ambergris, Cumin, Tropical Fruits, Patchouli, Gardenia and Ylang-Ylang. "A sunny holiday in a tropical paradise, all fun and games. Suddenly the night falls..." - a note from the brand.

name: Thousand Lakes
description: Thousand Lakes by V/SITEUR is a fragrance for women and men. Thousand Lakes was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Marie Schnirer. The fragrance features Birch Leaf, Watery Notes, Mineral notes, Black Currant, Herbal Notes, Smoke, Rhubarb, Leather, Musk and Woody Notes. "Run naked through green grass surrounded by birch trees into the dark, cold lake." - a note from the brand.

name: James
description: James by By / Rosie Jane is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women and men. James was launched in 2015. The fragrance features Gardenia, Fig and Amber. "A perfect blend of floral and earthy essential oils into a light Eau de Parfum, with notes of fig, amber and gardenia. Inspired by fall; James is light, earthy and romantic." - Brand website

name: Rosie
description: Rosie by By / Rosie Jane is a Floral fragrance for women and men. Rosie was launched in 2016. The fragrance features Musk, Red Rose, Moroccan Rose and Vanilla. With red rose, moroccan rose, nude musk, and a touch of vanilla blended into a light Eau de Parfum. Rosie is designed to feel perfectly sheer even under the layers of winter." - Brand Website.

name: Angie
description: Angie by By / Rosie Jane is a Floral fragrance for women and men. Angie was launched in 2018. The fragrance features Honeysuckle, Jasmine and Fig. "Honey suckle, jasmine and fig in a light Eau de Parfum. Angie is a love letter to Los Angeles." Brand Website.

name: Air
description: Air by E/4 Fragrance is a Floral Green fragrance for women and men. Air was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Claudette Belnavis. Top notes are Pink Pepper and Bergamot; middle notes are Herbal Notes and Wildflowers; base note is Grass. "For ethereal, air-personalities who have longed for a signature scent that captures their unique, charismatic personality. Full of clean laundry notes blended with bright slices of citrus and fresh wildflowers, it smells amazing on it's own, or layered with any or all of it's companion scents, Earth, Fire or Water."  Brand Website.

name: Earth
description: Earth by E/4 Fragrance is a Oriental Woody fragrance for women and men. Earth was launched in 2015. Top notes are Coriander Leaf, Clementine and Neroli; middle notes are Mimosa, Green Tea and Jasmine; base notes are Sandalwood, Vetiver and Amber. "For earthy personalities who have longed for a signature scent that captures their elegant, indulgent, determined personality. Full of clean, mossy green notes tempered with a spicy, exotic, floral note, it smells amazing on it's own, or layered with any or all of it's companion scents; Fire, Air or Water." -Brand Website.

name: Fire
description: Fire by E/4 Fragrance is a Oriental Spicy fragrance for women and men. Fire was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Patricia Choux. Top note is Cardamom; middle notes are Jasmine, Iris and Clary Sage; base note is Mahoganywood. "For firey personalities who have longed for a signature scent that captures their confident, expressive aura. Full of spicy, woodsy oriental notes and lush hits of tropical, heady flowers, it smells amazing on it's own, or layered with any or all of it's companion scents, Earth, Air or Water." - Brand Website.

name: Water
description: Water by E/4 Fragrance is a Floral Aquatic fragrance for women and men. Water was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Patricia Choux. Top notes are Seagrass and Mandarin Orange; middle notes are Sea Notes and Floral Notes; base notes are Mineral notes, Musk, Cedar and Green Tea. "For water babies who have longed for a signature scent that captures their cool, aquatic aura. Full of fresh, marine notes and creamy hits of sweet, white florals it smells amazing on it's own, or layered with any or all of it's companion scents, Earth, Air or Fire." -Brand Website.

name: Lake
description: Lake by By / Rosie Jane is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for women and men. Lake was launched in 2019. The fragrance features Citruses, Vanilla, Sandalwood and Bergamot. For the Fall of 2019, Rosie just launched a new addition to her fragrance line with the short and sweet name Lake. As the brand explains, "Lake is inspired by Fall and Lake Tahoe. It captures the bohemian in all of us."

name: Madie
description: Madie by By / Rosie Jane is a Floral fragrance for women and men. Madie was launched in 2020. The fragrance features Jasmine, Sea water, Coconut and Vanilla. "Madie is inspired by summer and sun-kissed skin and feels like beach in a bottle; oceanic, light and fresh." -Brand info.

name: Uriel Intense
description: Uriel Intense by INVISIBLE/HR1 is a Aromatic Spicy fragrance for men. Uriel Intense was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Hans Rivas. Top notes are Pineapple, Mint and Whiskey; middle notes are Guatemalan Cardamom, Coffee, Amber and Caramel; base note is Musk.

name: Dylan
description: Dylan by By / Rosie Jane is a Woody fragrance for women and men. Dylan was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Rosie Jane Johnston. The fragrance features Cedar, White Musk and Olibanum.
